# Life of Adam and Eve Chapter 16 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Latin MS (Vita Adae et Evae) | **Section:** Adam Falls Ill

---

**1** When Adam had lived nine hundred and thirty years and the time of his death was approaching, he summoned all his sons to him.

**2** They came to him — Seth and all the others — and he said to them: 'My sons, I am sick and in great pain.'

**3** His sons said to him: 'Father, what is this sickness that has come upon you?' Adam said: 'My children, great pain has seized me.'

**4** Seth said to his father Adam: 'My lord father, do you not know that God afflicts you with this sickness for your own sake, because he loves you and wishes to purify you?'

---
*LOGOS: formal equivalence; verse-only numbering.*
